headline: Signup keyboard flow improved; next iteration tackles chat safety reporting.
summary: Owner renewed autonomous product, design, UX and UI iteration. Business decisions block only dependent workstreams. The team now has a concrete code-reviewed experience queue and will continue independent improvements around host, email and release decisions.

Completed locally in main commit 3679cbf: signup focuses each new question, Enter advances text steps through existing validation, Back preserves answers, and submission locks navigation while retaining recovery after failure. Login copy now describes available sports sessions. This is an accessibility and comprehension repair, not a measured conversion claim.

Verification passed: 1,190 web tests, 32 focused tests, web typecheck, lint with zero errors and 11 existing warnings, and production build. A ten-step 390px browser walkthrough passed under normal and reduced motion, covering age/password/terms gates, custom sport entry, optional steps and failed submission. All browser API mutations were intercepted; no accounts or emails were created.

Worker recovery: cycle 665ef2b completed full checks and committed, then stopped because its older report could not replace a newer coordinator report. The repair validates both artifacts, preserves the newer report, and records superseded status without falsely claiming mirroring or live publication. Sixteen reporting/notification tests and 41 runtime checks pass. Restart confirmed at 2026-09-13T23:37:30Z; current cycle is in progress, not yet verified complete.

Next independent work: repair chat safety reporting. The chat dialog accepts 2,000 characters before prepending message evidence, exceeding the server combined limit; report-plus-block also omits the shared-event warning and optional safety exit used elsewhere. Reproduce with mocks and reuse existing safety behavior without weakening authorization or silently discarding evidence.

Following iterations: host edit recovery and timezone preservation, then stale-connection and failed-delete feedback in event chat. These are code-review findings with concrete acceptance criteria, not completed fixes or human research. See the maintained experience queue in the repository.

Production remains the approved release d7064b7 on deployment dpl_EjVfwK7QgEFbmeuAyL3RXxEVkzTc. Later signup and isolated joining/discovery changes are local. No new production deployment, outreach, spending or database mutation was performed in this cycle.

Personal-sender OAuth setup is paused while support sending access is clarified. The obsolete token-request card is withdrawn, not approved. Support identity is required for any separately authorized outreach. HQ reporting continues; missing email access does not block product iteration. Earlier anonymous counters are not verified real users, attendance or revenue.
